# Projections

`jb3_project()` projects the stock under constant catch (`catch`) or constant
$F/F_{MSY}$ (`fmsy`) scenarios, from the NUTS draws or from MVN draws at the
mode (generated if the fit has none), with process error (and its AR(1)
persistence and the lag).

```{r proj}
pj <- jb3_project(fit, catch = c(60000, 70000, 80000), nyears = 10)
pj$scenarios
head(pj$ts[pj$ts$quantity == "B/Bmsy", ], 4)
```

`p.above` is the probability of being above the reference ($B > B_{MSY}$ or
$F < F_{MSY}$).

```{r proj-plot, fig.height = 6}
jbplot_projection(pj)
```

```{r proj-f, fig.height = 6}
pf <- jb3_project(rec, fmsy = c(0.5, 0.8, 1), nyears = 10)
jbplot_projection(pf)
```
